_comment: Mutation testing per ADR-020. Scoped to packages/core because that is where a surviving mutant means a wrong score for a real person. Run with `pnpm mutate`.
_pluginsComment: pnpm's isolated node_modules means Stryker cannot auto-discover its plugins; they must be named explicitly or it fails with 'no TestRunner plugins were loaded'.
_thresholdComment: RATCHET, not an aspiration. `break` sits just below the measured score so it can never get WORSE without failing the build. Measured 65.03% on 2026-08-12 (break 64); 80.42% on 2026-08-13; 80.39% on 2026-08-14 after ADR-031/ADR-032; 80.02% on 2026-08-14 after the adversarial fix round (12m01s). `break` stays at 79 — the convention here is about a point of headroom below the measurement, not a ceiling pressed against it. Raise it as survivors fall; NEVER lower it without a HONESTY_LOG entry saying why. ADR-023 E4 requires >=75 overall with no extraction or scoring module below 60; both hold, the weakest being experience.ts at 69.36% (down from 71.04% — see H-110, it is the file this project changes most and pins least well).
